snippet.title: Worms Galactic Tactics Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3278930/Worms_Galactic_Tactics/

The Future Games Show at gamescom began with the trailer for Worms Galactic Tactics, a spinoff entry in the slapstick turn-based strategy series. It’s coming to PC & consoles in 2027, and if you’re a fan of the 2D style the series is known for, the trailer also revealed that a brand-new mainline Worms game is in development.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
